import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder, StandardScaler
from sklearn.feature_selection import VarianceThreshold

# -------------------- LOAD & TRANSFORM TRAINING DATA --------------------
train_df = pd.read_csv("training_data_external.csv")

# Transpose: each column becomes a row 
X_train = train_df.iloc[1:, 1:].T
X_train.columns = train_df.iloc[1:, 0].astype(float)  # Time points as feature names

# Convert all to numeric
X_train = X_train.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors='coerce')

# Extract clean labels from column names 
labels_raw = train_df.columns[1:]
y_raw = [label.split('.')[0].strip().lower() for label in labels_raw]

# Encode labels
le = LabelEncoder()
y_encoded = le.fit_transform(y_raw)

# -------------------- HANDLE ZEROS & MISSING VALUES --------------------
# Treat zeros as missing values 
X_train.replace(0, np.nan, inplace=True)

# Drop any columns that are fully NaN
X_train_cleaned = X_train.dropna(axis=1, how='all')

# Impute missing values with mean
imputer = SimpleImputer(strategy='mean')
X_train_imputed = pd.DataFrame(
    imputer.fit_transform(X_train_cleaned),
    columns=X_train_cleaned.columns
)

# -------------------- FEATURE SELECTION & SCALING --------------------
# Remove low-variance features
selector = VarianceThreshold(threshold=1e-6)
X_train_selected = selector.fit_transform(X_train_imputed)

# Standard scaling
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_train_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_train_selected)

# Final outputs for modeling
X_train_final = X_train_scaled
y_train_final = y_encoded
In [2]:
# -------------------- LOAD & TRANSFORM EVALUATION DATA --------------------
eval_df = pd.read_csv("evaluation_data_external.csv")

# Transpose: rows = samples, columns = time points
X_eval = eval_df.T.reset_index(drop=True)
X_eval.columns = eval_df.iloc[:, 0].astype(float)

# Convert all to numeric
X_eval = X_eval.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors='coerce')

# Replace zeros with NaN
X_eval.replace(0, np.nan, inplace=True)

# Drop any columns that were dropped during training
X_eval_aligned = X_eval.iloc[:, :X_train_cleaned.shape[1]]  # align by column position

# Impute using training-fitted imputer
X_eval_imputed = pd.DataFrame(
    imputer.transform(X_eval_aligned),
    columns=X_train_cleaned.columns[:X_eval_aligned.shape[1]],
    index=X_eval.index
)

# Apply same feature selector
X_eval_selected = selector.transform(X_eval_imputed)

# Apply same scaler
X_eval_final = scaler.transform(X_eval_selected)

from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import classification_report, confusion_matrix, ConfusionMatrixDisplay
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# -------------------- Split the Training Data --------------------
X_train_split, X_val_split, y_train_split, y_val_split = train_test_split(
    X_train_final, y_train_final,
    test_size=0.2,
    stratify=y_train_final,
    random_state=42
)

# -------------------- Train the Model on Training Split --------------------
model = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=300,
    class_weight={0: 1, 1: 5},
    random_state=42
)
model.fit(X_train_split, y_train_split)

# -------------------- Predict on Validation Split --------------------
perfect_index = le.transform(['perfect'])[0]
val_probs = model.predict_proba(X_val_split)[:, perfect_index]

# Apply threshold, I initially used 0.30, but later increased to 0.40
threshold = 0.40
binary_preds = (val_probs > threshold).astype(int)
y_val_pred = np.full_like(y_val_split, fill_value=le.transform(['imperfect'])[0])
y_val_pred[binary_preds == 1] = perfect_index

# -------------------- Evaluate --------------------
print("Classification Report (Validation Set, Threshold = 0.30):")
print(classification_report(y_val_split, y_val_pred, target_names=le.classes_))

# Confusion Matrix
cm = confusion_matrix(y_val_split, y_val_pred)
ConfusionMatrixDisplay(confusion_matrix=cm, display_labels=le.classes_).plot(cmap='Purples')
plt.title("Confusion Matrix (Validation Split, Threshold = 0.30)")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

from sklearn.metrics import f1_score, precision_score, recall_score
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

thresholds = np.arange(0.20, 0.46, 0.05)
perfect_index = le.transform(['perfect'])[0]

macro_f1s = []
perfect_recalls = []
perfect_precisions = []

for threshold in thresholds:
    probs = model.predict_proba(X_val_split)[:, perfect_index]
    
    # Apply threshold
    binary_preds = (probs > threshold).astype(int)
    preds = np.full_like(y_val_split, fill_value=le.transform(['imperfect'])[0])
    preds[binary_preds == 1] = perfect_index
    
    # Metrics
    macro_f1s.append(f1_score(y_val_split, preds, average='macro'))
    perfect_recalls.append(recall_score(y_val_split, preds, pos_label=perfect_index, zero_division=0))
    perfect_precisions.append(precision_score(y_val_split, preds, pos_label=perfect_index, zero_division=0))

# Plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(thresholds, macro_f1s, label="Macro F1", marker='o')
plt.plot(thresholds, perfect_recalls, label="Perfect Recall", marker='o')
plt.plot(thresholds, perfect_precisions, label="Perfect Precision", marker='o')
plt.title("Threshold Tuning Curve (Validation Split)")
plt.xlabel("Threshold")
plt.ylabel("Score")
plt.ylim(0, 1.05)
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import classification_report, confusion_matrix, ConfusionMatrixDisplay
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt


perfect_index = le.transform(['perfect'])[0]
threshold = 0.30

skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=3, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

all_true = []
all_preds = []

# -------------------- Cross-Validation Loop --------------------
for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X_train_final, y_train_final), start=1):
    X_train_fold, X_val_fold = X_train_final[train_idx], X_train_final[val_idx]
    y_train_fold, y_val_fold = y_train_final[train_idx], y_train_final[val_idx]

    model2 = RandomForestClassifier(
        n_estimators=300,
        class_weight={0: 1, 1: 5},
        random_state=42
    )
    model2.fit(X_train_fold, y_train_fold)

    val_probs = model2.predict_proba(X_val_fold)[:, perfect_index]
    binary_preds = (val_probs > threshold).astype(int)
    y_val_pred = np.full_like(y_val_fold, fill_value=le.transform(['imperfect'])[0])
    y_val_pred[binary_preds == 1] = perfect_index

    print(f"\n Fold {fold}")
    print(classification_report(y_val_fold, y_val_pred, target_names=le.classes_))

    # Store results
    all_true.extend(y_val_fold)
    all_preds.extend(y_val_pred)

# -------------------- Evaluation --------------------
print("\n Combined Classification Report (Across All Folds):")
print(classification_report(all_true, all_preds, target_names=le.classes_))

cm = confusion_matrix(all_true, all_preds)
ConfusionMatrixDisplay(confusion_matrix=cm, display_labels=le.classes_).plot(cmap="Purples")
plt.title("Confusion Matrix (Cross-Validated)")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
